items.label: Peer Mediation
items.description: Trained members within the organization mediate disputes among peers.

items.label: Conflict Resolution Council
items.description: Senior members with institutional knowledge provide guidance or decisions.

items.label: Facilitated Negotiation
items.description: A neutral facilitator helps guide the negotiation process.

items.label: Ad Hoc Arbitration
items.description: Arbitrators are chosen specifically for a particular case.

items.label: Conflict Workshops
items.description: Structured sessions where parties collaboratively resolve disputes and improve future interactions.

items.label: Supermajority Vote
items.description: Members vote to resolve a dispute democratically.

items.label: Interest-Based Bargaining
items.description: Focuses on underlying interests rather than fixed positions to find win-win solutions.

items.label: Restorative Practices
items.description: Dialogue-focused methods for understanding and repairing harm.

items.label: Mediation
items.description: A neutral third party assists parties in reaching a voluntary agreement.

items.label: Circle Processes
items.description: A structured format for open dialogue with equal input from all involved.

items.label: Judicial Committees
items.description: A standing committee responsible for adjudicating disputes.

items.label: Managerial Decision
items.description: A manager or leader makes a binding decision.

items.label: Internal Tribunal
items.description: A formal hearing body within the organization.

items.label: Consensus Building
items.description: Collaborative work to reach a resolution that all parties can agree upon.

items.label: Binding Arbitration
items.description: An external arbitrator makes a binding decision.

items.label: Non-Binding Arbitration
items.description: An arbitrator gives a recommendation that is not binding.

items.label: Binding Contracts
items.description: Legal agreements that define resolution methods.

items.label: Lottery/Sortition
items.description: Random selection used to resolve low-stakes disputes or select juries.

items.label: Rotational Judging
items.description: A rotating set of members is assigned to handle conflicts.
